s: Which organisation from YSR Kadapa district received Guinness World Record and World Record Union certificates for the online sale of SHG products?
x: MEPMA of YSR Kadapa district got the Guinness World Record and World Record Union certificates for selling over 1 lakh SHG products online in a day on 8 March 2025. ONDC and WOW.GENI were its partners in the sale.

s: Which European peak was climbed by AP Police Railways wing DSP Harshitha Manikanta?
x: DSP Harshitha Manikanta of the AP Police Railways wing climbed Mount Elbrus, the highest peak in Europe. Mount Everest, Aconcagua and Denali are listed as peaks of Asia, South America and North America respectively.

s: Mount Elbrus (5,642 m) lies in which mountain range?
x: Mount Elbrus lies in the Caucasus Range on the Russia–Georgia border; it is a dormant stratovolcano.

s: For completing 50 years as a lead hero, Nandamuri Balakrishna was included in which edition of the World Book of Records, U.K.?
x: He was included in the Gold Edition, not the Platinum Edition.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Nandamuri Balakrishna?
o: He made his debut as a child artist in 1974.
His child-artist debut film was Mangammagari Manavadu.
He is a TDP MLA from Hindupur.
He is Chairman of Basavatarakam Indo American Cancer Hospital & Research Institute.
x: His child-artist debut was in 1974 in Tatamma Kala; Mangammagari Manavadu came later in his film career.

s: What is the height of Aconcagua, the highest peak of South America?
x: Aconcagua is 6,961 metres high; 6,190 m is Denali, 5,642 m Elbrus and 8,848 m Everest.

s: Nandamuri Balakrishna is a TDP MLA from which constituency?
x: Nandamuri Balakrishna is a TDP MLA from Hindupur. Bheemili and Visakhapatnam are connected with the school in the Sridevi report, while Chittoor is associated with SP Manikantha Chandolu.

s: Which of the following pairs of continent and highest peak is correctly matched?
x: Vinson Massif (4,892 m) is Antarctica's highest peak; Kilimanjaro is in Africa and Elbrus in Europe.

s: To whom was the Guinness certificate for the 11th International Day of Yoga record at Visakhapatnam presented?
x: The Guinness certificate was presented to IT & HRD Minister Nara Lokesh.

s: Who is the para-swimmer from Eluru associated with the English Channel and Palk Strait achievements?
x: Balaga Ganesh, a para-swimmer from Eluru, swam the Palk Strait solo (first para-swimmer from the Telugu States) and crossed the English Channel in a six-member relay. Murlikant Petkar won India's first Paralympic swimming gold in 1972, and Siviku Bangarayya is a teacher.

s: For whom was the Yogandhra campaign of 2025 conducted?
o: All people, statewide in rural and urban areas
x: Yogandhra was a statewide campaign covering rural and urban areas and all sections of people.

s: The Palk Strait links the Bay of Bengal with which water body?
x: The Palk Strait, between Tamil Nadu and Sri Lanka, links the Bay of Bengal and the Gulf of Mannar.

s: Who won India’s first Paralympic swimming gold in 1972 in the 50 m freestyle?
x: Murlikant Petkar won India’s first Paralympic swimming gold in 1972 in the 50 m freestyle. Balaga Ganesh, Siviku Bangarayya and Jahnavi Dangeti are associated with other news developments.

s: In which event did Jyothi Yarraji win gold at the 2025 Asian Athletics Championships, Gumi?
x: She won the women's 100 m hurdles in 12.96 s, a championship record, retaining her 2023 title.

s: Jyothi Yarraji of Visakhapatnam received which national sports award in 2024?
x: Jyothi Yarraji is an Arjuna Award (2024) recipient.

s: In which sport did Juitha Guna of Rajamahendravaram win gold in the 69 kg Youth category at the Commonwealth Championship 2025?
x: She won gold at the Commonwealth Weightlifting Championship 2025, Ahmedabad.

s: Where was the Asian Schools Chess Championship 2025, in which AP players won 3 of India's 8 medals, held?
x: It was held at Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.

s:
Consider the following statements about para-swimmer Balaga Ganesh:
1. He crossed the Palk Strait solo.
2. He crossed the English Channel solo.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The Palk Strait swim was solo, but the English Channel crossing was a six-member relay.

s: Which district ranked No. 1 in the Yogandhra rankings with 8 lakh+ people at 5,050 locations?
x: Annamayya district was No. 1, with its main event at Rayachoti.

s: In the National Sports Awards 2025, how many Arjuna awards were given?
x: Only 17 Arjuna awards were given, none to an AP athlete, and no Khel Ratna was given.

s: How did Balaga Ganesh cross the English Channel from England to France on 16 June 2024?
x: It was part of the six-member relay 'Pride of India – A Team'; his Palk Strait crossing was solo.

s: Where was the Guinness World Record for the largest gathering for a yoga session at a single venue set on 21 June 2025?
x: About 3 lakh people did yoga along a 28 km stretch from RK Beach, Visakhapatnam, on the 11th International Day of Yoga.

s: Who led Andhra Pradesh's statewide 'Super GST – Super Savings' campaign on the benefits of GST 2.0?
x: The campaign was led by Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu.

s: What was planned as the finale of Andhra Pradesh’s “Super GST – Super Savings” campaign around Diwali?
o: Shopping festivals and cultural programmes at district headquarters
MSME fairs in every mandal headquarters
Essay and painting contests in schools
x: The finale consisted of shopping festivals and cultural programmes at district headquarters around Diwali. The other options describe campaign activities but not its finale.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the impact of GST 2.0 on Andhra Pradesh?
o: The estimated annual loss to the State was ₹1,500–7,000 crore
PMAY completion in the State reached 40% in five years
AP GST collections rose 21% in August 2025 to ₹3,989 crore
SFURTI benefited 8,492 AP artisans in five years
x: PMAY completion was only 35% in five years, not 40%.

s: At the 44th India International Trade Fair 2025, which districts showcased pickles and condiments?
x: Krishna & Guntur showcased pickles and condiments; Nellore showed crochet lace and Kadapa handicrafts and mineral-based products.

s: Under GST 2.0, to what rate was the GST on farm machinery changed from 12%?
x: Farm machinery moved from 12% to 5%, not 18%.

s: Under GST 2.0, to what rate was the GST on cement reduced from 28%?
x: Cement moved from 28% to 18%; marble, granite and bricks moved from 12% to 5%.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about AP's 'Super GST – Super Savings' campaign?
o: It included tractor rallies and bike rallies
It included MSME fairs and essay and painting contests
Its finale was shopping festivals and cultural programmes around Diwali
It targeted 6,500 meetings and events by 19 October 2025
x: The campaign targeted 65,000 meetings and events, not 6,500; the other features are correct.

s: What was the theme of the Andhra Pradesh pavilion’s participation in the 44th India International Trade Fair 2025?
x: The theme of the 44th India International Trade Fair 2025 was “Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat.” The other options are associated with broader national initiatives but were not the stated theme of this event.

s: Which organisation organised the 44th India International Trade Fair 2025?
o: Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry
x: The 44th IITF 2025 was organised by the India Trade Promotion Organisation; the Andhra Pradesh pavilion was a participant.

s: What did Chittoor district showcase at the 44th India International Trade Fair 2025?
x: Chittoor showcased wooden carvings; Uppada sarees came from Kakinada.

s: Etikoppaka toys, shown at the 44th IITF 2025, are made from which wood?
x: Etikoppaka toys of Anakapalli district are made of Ankudu wood; GI tag 2017.

s: Etikoppaka village, known for its GI-tagged toys, lies on which river?
x: Etikoppaka lies on the Varaha river in Anakapalli district.

s: Under GST 2.0, to what rate was the GST on handicrafts such as Kondapalli and Etikoppaka toys cut from 12%?
x: Handicrafts moved from 12% to 5% under GST 2.0.

s: Where was the 44th India International Trade Fair 2025 held?
x: The 44th IITF opened on 14 November 2025 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.

s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh's GST collections in August 2025:
1. They rose by 21%.
2. They amounted to ₹3,989 crore.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both are correct: AP's GST collections rose 21% to ₹3,989 crore in August 2025.

s: At the 44th India International Trade Fair 2025, Uppada sarees were showcased from which district?
x: Kakinada district showed Uppada sarees at the AP pavilion of IITF 2025.

s: Which district showcased Kalamkari and Pen Kalamkari (Srikalahasti) at the 44th India International Trade Fair 2025?
x: Srikalahasti Kalamkari and Pen Kalamkari represented Tirupati district.

s: Which former DRDO Chairman assumed charge as Advisor for Aerospace and Defence to the Andhra Pradesh government in May 2025?
x: Dr G Satish Reddy, former DRDO Chairman, assumed charge as Advisor for Aerospace and Defence to the AP government.

s: What was the aim of appointing Dr G. Satish Reddy as Advisor for Aerospace and Defence to the AP government?
o: To shift the DRDO headquarters to Andhra Pradesh
To build a new launch pad at Sriharikota
To make Andhra Pradesh a global hub for defence industries and create jobs
To set up a defence university in Amaravati
x: The objective was to make Andhra Pradesh a global hub for defence industries and generate jobs.

s: What is the role of the Andhra Pradesh Group of Ministers formed to oversee social media?
x: The GoM only makes recommendations, such as suggesting nodal agencies or oversight bodies, and has no direct enforcement powers.

s: On which date was the Andhra Pradesh Group of Ministers to oversee and regulate social media platforms formed?
x: The GoM was formed on 2 October 2025; the central law in its terms of reference is the IT Act, 2000.

s: From which High Court was Justice Subhendu Samanta transferred to the Andhra Pradesh High Court?
x: He was transferred from the Calcutta High Court; such transfers are made by the President under Article 222(1) after consulting the CJI.

s: Who is the convenor of the Andhra Pradesh Group of Ministers formed to oversee and regulate social media platforms?
o: The Minister for IT and HRD
The Commissioner/Director of Information & Public Relations
x: The Commissioner/Director of Information & Public Relations is the convenor of the Group of Ministers. The other options identify ministers or an official associated with different roles and portfolios.

s: Who issued the Gazette notification of 14 October 2025 on the appointment of Justice Subhendu Samanta to the Andhra Pradesh High Court?
o: The Chief Justice of the AP High Court
x: The Gazette notification dated 14 October 2025 was issued by President Droupadi Murmu.

s: In Andhra Pradesh's Group of Ministers on social media, Nara Lokesh holds which portfolio?
x: Nara Lokesh holds IT and HRD; Vangalapudi Anitha holds Home, Satya Kumar Yadav Medical and Health and Nadendla Manohar Civil Supplies.

s: In the case of Shabana, a trans woman, the Andhra Pradesh High Court upheld her right to invoke which provision?
x: The Court upheld her right to invoke Section 498A, though the charges were quashed for lack of evidence.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the AP High Court ruling in the case concerning a trans woman?
o: The charges were quashed on gender grounds.
The case was heard by Justice Venkata Jyothirmai Pratapa.
The petition was filed by Viswanathan Krishnamurthy and his parents against a case by Shabana.
Article 15 bars discrimination on the ground of sex.
x: The charges were quashed for lack of evidence, not on gender grounds.

s: In its ruling concerning a trans woman, the Andhra Pradesh High Court cited which Articles as the constitutional basis?
x: The constitutional basis cited comprised Articles 14, 15 and 21.

s: On which date was a Special Task Force constituted to probe the March 2022 Jangareddygudem spurious liquor deaths?
x: The STF was constituted on 20 May 2025 on the DGP's recommendation.

s: Who, as Chairman of the Swachh Andhra Corporation, announced that AP would adopt a Circular Economy Policy claimed to be India's first?
x: Pattabhi Ram Kommareddy, Chairman of the Swachh Andhra Corporation, announced the Circular Economy Policy.

s: Where is the ancestral village of Usha Vance, wife of US Vice President JD Vance?
x: Usha Vance (née Chilukuri) has her ancestral village at Vadluru near Tanuku, West Godavari.

s: Which Minister of the AP social-media Group of Ministers holds Housing and I&PR?
x: Kolusu Parthasarathy holds Housing and I&PR.

s: Before whom did Justice Subhendu Samanta take his oath as an Andhra Pradesh High Court judge on 29 October 2025?
x: The oath was administered by AP HC Chief Justice Dhiraj Singh Thakur in the First Court Hall.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about AP's Group of Ministers on social media?
o: Its convenor is the Commissioner/Director of I&PR
The central law on the subject is the IT Act, 2000
It has powers to enforce penalties on platforms
x: The GoM only recommends; it has no enforcement powers.

s: Which Slum Level Federation honoured through MEPMA at the Swachha Andhra Awards 2025 won for Terrace Garden?
x: Prakasam's federation won for Terrace Garden; Srikakulam and Visakhapatnam won for Home Compost, and Kurnool was not among them.

s: Where was the Global Tourism Award 2025 presented to the Andhra Pradesh Tourism Department?
x: The award ceremony was held in New Delhi. Gandikota was recognised for its eco-tourism and adventure-tourism development, but it was not the venue of the ceremony.

s: Who instituted the Global Tourism Award 2025 received by the Andhra Pradesh Tourism Department?
x: The award was instituted by the Global News Network, not by the AP Tourism Department.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about MEPMA's award at the Swachha Andhra Awards 2025?
o: It won the Best Social Media Management category.
The award was received by N. Tej Bharath, MEPMA Mission Director.
It was chosen from among 19 departments.
x: MEPMA won the Best Social Media Management award among 19 departments, not 19 municipalities.

s: How many MoUs did Andhra Pradesh Tourism sign in the 15 months before winning the Global Tourism Award 2025?
x: Andhra Pradesh signed 103 MoUs in the preceding 15 months.

s: Which of the following pairs (Swachha Andhra Awards 2025) is correctly matched?
o: Best Swachha NGO – SS Palm Tree Villas Association
Swachha Municipality (1–3 lakh population) – Mana Ooru, Mana Gudi, Mana Bhadyatha
x: Anantapur won Best Swachha District 2025; Tadipatri won the municipality category, SS Palm Tree Villas Association won Swachha Colonies and Mana Ooru, Mana Gudi, Mana Bhadyatha won Best Swachha NGO.

s: The new Andhra Pradesh tourism policy, linked to the state's Global Tourism Award 2025, includes which model?
x: The new tourism policy includes a Public-Private Partnership model, a roadmap for investors and an emphasis on eco-friendly, sustainable development.

s: In September 2025, Andhra Pradesh received the Central Silk Board's Best State Award under which programme?
x: AP received the Best State Award under Mera Resham – Mera Abhiman at the Central Silk Board's 76th Foundation Day in Bengaluru on 20 September 2025.

s: What is the 'Mera Resham – Mera Abhiman' programme meant for?
x: Mera Resham – Mera Abhiman is a farmer-awareness programme, not one for SEZ exports.

s: In which year was the Central Silk Board established under the Ministry of Textiles?
x: The Central Silk Board was established in 1948 under the Ministry of Textiles.

s: Which two initiatives of the Andhra Pradesh Revenue Department won the SKOCH Awards 2025?
o: Online Court Management System and Swachh Ratham
Online Court Management System and Re-Survey 2.0
Swachh Ratham and Circular Economy Policy
x: The two award-winning initiatives were the Online Court Management System, which digitised revenue courts, and Re-Survey 2.0, which used drones and GIS mapping of land records. Swachh Ratham and the Circular Economy Policy belong to a different Andhra Pradesh initiative.

s: Who gives the SKOCH Awards, two of which were won by the AP Revenue Department in 2025?
x: The SKOCH Awards are given by the SKOCH Group, an independent think tank, not by the Government of India.

s: What is the full form of MEPMA in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Municipal Employment and Poverty Mitigation Agency
Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas
Mission for Empowerment of Poor in Municipal Areas
Municipal Engineering and Planning Management Authority
x: MEPMA is the Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas, launched in 2007.

s: Which district was adjudged the Best Swachha District at the Swachha Andhra Awards 2025?
x: Anantapur was the Best Swachha District 2025; Tadipatri won among municipalities.

s: In which city did Andhra Pradesh receive the Mera Resham – Mera Abhiman Best State Award at the Central Silk Board's 76th Foundation Day?
x: It was presented at the 76th Foundation Day of the CSB in Bengaluru on 20 September 2025.

s: Which AP department won the Best Tableau award on Independence Day 2025?
x: The AP Sericulture Department won the Best Tableau on Independence Day 2025.

s: Which publication was released during the Ugadi Puraskaralu 2025 programme?
x: The Vishwavasu Nama Samvatsara Panchangam of TTD was released during Ugadi Puraskaralu 2025.

s: The Samvatsara cycle associated with Ugadi consists of how many years?
x: The Samvatsara cycle has 60 years; Ugadi falls on the first day of Chaitra.

s: Which of the following pairs related to New Year observances is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Bitter taste in Ugadi Pachadi – Neem flowers
x: Puthandu is Tamil Nadu's New Year; Karnataka celebrates Ugadi.

s: How many persons received the Kalaratna (Hamsa) award at the Ugadi Puraskaralu 2025?
x: 86 got the Kalaratna (Hamsa) and 121 the Ugadi Puraskar – 207 in all.

s: What cash award did each Ugadi Puraskar 2025 awardee receive?
x: The Ugadi Puraskar carries ₹10,000; the Kalaratna (Hamsa) carries ₹50,000.

s: Along with the Endowments Department, which body organised the Ugadi Puraskaralu 2025?
o: AP State Creativity and Culture Commission
x: They were organised by the AP State Creativity and Culture Commission and the Endowments Department.

s: Where was the 56th IFFI held, at which Andhra Pradesh's tableau 'Hear the Beat of Indian Cinema and Tourism' won first prize?
x: The 56th IFFI was held at Panaji, Goa, on 20–28 November 2025.

s: For the largest number of what did the Vijayawada Dasara Carnival of 2 October 2025 set a Guinness World Record?
x: Over 1,000 drummers set the record for the largest number of drum artists performing together.

s: How are meritorious sportspersons selected under the 3% horizontal reservation in AP direct recruitment?
o: Through an interview conducted by district collectors
Through a written examination conducted by the Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh
Through a written examination conducted only by APPSC
Without a written examination, from a State Level Committee merit list via APPSC and other boards
x: Selection is made without a written examination, on the merit list prepared by the State Level Committee through APPSC and other boards.

s: On which date was the 3% horizontal reservation for meritorious sportspersons in AP direct recruitment notified under the AP Sports Policy 2024–29?
x: The reservation was notified on 20 April 2025 under the AP Sports Policy 2024–29.

s: The 3% sports quota notified in Andhra Pradesh is valid for how long, or until a new policy is introduced?
x: The quota is valid for five years or until a new policy; it covers 65 sports, verified by SAAP.

s: What is the sports quota in government jobs and professional-course admissions under the Andhra Pradesh Sports Policy?
x: The Andhra Pradesh Sports Policy provides a 3% reservation for sportspersons in government jobs and professional-course admissions.

s: Which of the following is NOT a feature of the AP Sports Policy (APSES 2024-25)?
o: A separate sports capital at Kakinada
x: The policy provides for one ground per village, a Sports City in Amaravati and 3% reservation for sportspersons. It does not provide for a separate sports capital at Kakinada.

s: With which vision is the AP Sports Policy (APSES 2024-25) aligned?
x: The AP Sports Policy is aligned with Swarna Andhra Sports Vision 2047.

s: How many sports are covered under Andhra Pradesh's 3% sports quota?
x: The 3% sports quota covers 65 sports in two disciplines, verified by SAAP.

s: Where is a Sports City planned under the AP Sports Policy 2024–29?
x: The Sports City is planned in Amaravati; there is no sports capital at Kakinada.

s: M. Thirumala Sridevi, the only Andhra Pradesh teacher to receive the National Best Teacher Award 2025, heads a school at which place?
x: Madabathula Thirumala Sridevi is headmistress of Pandit Nehru Municipal High School, Bheemili; she was the only AP teacher among the 45 selected nationally.

s: Who presented the National Best Teacher Award 2025 to M. Thirumala Sridevi on 5 September 2025?
x: President Droupadi Murmu presented the award on 5 September 2025, observed as Teachers' Day.

s: Who presented the Guru Brahma Award 2025 to Siviku Bangarayya?
x: The award was presented by All The Best Academy, Hyderabad, for his free coaching and study material to underprivileged students.

s: For which work did Prasad Suri win the Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar 2025 (Telugu)?
x: Prasad Suri won the Yuva Puraskar for the novel Mairaavana; Kaburla Devatha won the Bal Sahitya Puraskar.

s: Gangisetti Sivakumar's 'Kaburla Devatha' won which Sahitya Akademi award in 2025?
x: Kaburla Devatha (stories) won the Bal Sahitya Puraskar 2025.

s: How many teachers nationwide received the National Best Teacher Award 2025?
x: 45 teachers got the award; M. Thirumala Sridevi was the only one from AP.

s: Which title did Varadarajan Sharma of National Sanskrit University, Tirupati, receive for his performance in the 'Tenali Examination'?
x: He received the 'Advaita Vedanta Ratna' title from Sri Sankara Vijayendra Saraswati of Kanchi Kamakoti Peetham.

s: Which award did Siviku Bangarayya, a government school teacher of Vizianagaram district, receive along with the Guru Brahma Award 2025?
o: Dr. N.T. Rama Rao National Seva Ratna Award
x: He got the Dr. N.T. Rama Rao National Seva Ratna Award 2025 and Guru Brahma Award 2025 from All The Best Academy, Hyderabad, for free coaching.

s: At which place was tentative approval given for a 58-ft statue of Amarajeevi Potti Sriramulu?
x: The tentative approval was given for a 58-ft statue of Potti Sriramulu at Amaravati. Nellore was associated with the announcement and the proposed naming of a new market, not the statue site.

s: Which freedom fighter from Andhra Pradesh took part in the Salt Satyagraha and later became an MP?
x: Sangam Lakshmi Bai took part in the Salt Satyagraha and later became an MP; Durgabai Deshmukh was a Constituent Assembly member and Pingali Venkayya designed the national flag.

s: Which of the following is correct about Tanguturi Prakasam's professional background?
o: He was a civil servant who studied in Amaravati and practised in Madras
He was a barrister who studied in England and practised in Ongole
He was a journalist who studied in Madras and practised in England
He was a barrister who studied in England and practised in Madras
x: Prakasam was a barrister, studied in England and practised in Madras. The trap is the substitution of Ongole for Madras as the place of his legal practice.

s: Which of the following pairs of freedom fighters from Andhra Pradesh is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy – Armed uprising of 1857
Tanguturi Prakasam – First Chief Minister of Andhra State
x: Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy led the armed uprising of 1846, not 1857.

s: Which freedom fighter from Andhra Pradesh organised women in the Civil Disobedience movement?
x: Bharati Devi Ranga organised women in Civil Disobedience; Garimella Satyanarayana was known for patriotic songs and Konda Venkatappayya for Krishna Patrika.

s: For facing the police during which event did Tanguturi Prakasam earn the title 'Andhra Kesari'?
x: His courageous confrontation with the police during the 1928 Simon Commission black-flag protest earned him the title 'Andhra Kesari'.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the proposed Potti Sriramulu statue in Amaravati?
o: The statue will be 58 ft tall.
Andhra State was formed in 1956 after Potti Sriramulu's death.
The statue is linked to his 125th birth anniversary.
Potti Sriramulu fasted unto death for a separate Andhra State.
x: Andhra State was formed in 1953, not 1956.

s: Which set of movements was associated with Tanguturi Prakasam?
o: Quit India, Rampa Rebellion and Krishna Patrika movement
Rampa Rebellion, Pullari Satyagraha and Salt Satyagraha
Simon Commission, armed uprising of 1846 and Civil Disobedience
Non-Cooperation, Civil Disobedience and Quit India
x: Prakasam participated in the Non-Cooperation, Civil Disobedience and Quit India movements. The Rampa Rebellion and Pullari Satyagraha are associated with other freedom fighters from Andhra Pradesh.

s: Tanguturi Prakasam was the first Chief Minister of which State?
x: Tanguturi Prakasam was the first Chief Minister of Andhra State, formed in 1953. He was not the first CM of Andhra Pradesh, which was formed in 1956.

s: What does the honorific 'Amarajeevi' given to Potti Sriramulu mean?
x: 'Amarajeevi' means 'immortal soul'; 'Lion of Andhra' (Andhra Kesari) was Tanguturi Prakasam's title.

s: Which flower was the State symbol of undivided Andhra Pradesh, before residual AP adopted Jasmine?
x: The Water Lily (and the Indian Roller bird) were old united-AP symbols; residual AP's flower is Jasmine.

s: With which movement is Kanneganti Hanumanthu associated?
x: Kanneganti Hanumanthu led the Pullari Satyagraha in Palnadu against forest taxes.

s: Who among the following designed the national flag of India?
x: Pingali Venkayya of Andhra designed the national flag.

s: Who was the editor of 'Krishna Patrika'?
x: Freedom fighter Konda Venkatappayya was the editor of Krishna Patrika.

s: Which freedom fighter from Andhra Pradesh was a member of the Constituent Assembly?
x: Durgabai Deshmukh was a member of the Constituent Assembly.

s: Tanguturi Prakasam was the Premier of which Presidency during 1946-47?
x: Tanguturi Prakasam was Premier of the Madras Presidency in 1946-47, before becoming the first CM of Andhra State.

s: Where was Tanguturi Prakasam born?
x: Prakasam was born on 23 August 1872 at Vinodarayunipalem near Ongole.

s: Where was the 17th-century Telugu inscription discovered in Prakasam district?
x: The inscription was discovered at Anantararayunipalli village in Komarolu Mandal of Prakasam district. Ganupulapalli was mentioned in the inscription as a land grant, not as the place of discovery.

s: For services to which deity does the 17th-century Telugu inscription found in Prakasam district record a land grant?
x: It records a grant of Ganupulapalli village and lands in Bomggaraputi for services to Lord Hanumanta.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Centre of Excellence for Studies in Classical Telugu (CESCT)?
o: It was launched in Mysuru in 2018
It was shifted to Nellore in 2018
It was shifted at the instance of then Vice-President M. Venkaiah Naidu
It is now located at Nellore
x: CESCT was launched in Mysuru in 2018 and shifted to Nellore in 2019, not 2018.

s: In which year was Telugu recognised as a classical language?
x: Telugu was recognised as a classical language in 2008, not 2010.

s: Which classical work was translated by the Centre of Excellence for Studies in Classical Telugu?
x: The Centre translated “Kreedabhiramamu” and published Dr. Emani Sivanagireddy's “Mana Telugu Vari Sasanalu”.

s: Erra Matti Dibbalu was one of how many Indian sites added to the UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List?
x: It was one of seven Indian sites added to the Tentative List; it is also one of India's 34 National Geo-heritage Sites.

s: What causes the distinctive red colour of Erra Matti Dibbalu?
x: The red colour comes from ferrous minerals reacting with moisture; the dunes themselves formed during the Last Glacial Maximum.

s: Under the IKS Division of which body does the Indian Knowledge Systems Centre at National Sanskrit University, Tirupati, come?
x: The centre is under the IKS Division of the Ministry of Education.

s: What was the name of the legal conclave organised by the Valmiki Research Centre affiliated to National Sanskrit University?
x: The legal conclave was named “Sri Ramayana Sankharavam.” The other titles are not the name of the conclave organised by the Valmiki Research Centre.

s: Where was the legal conclave 'Sri Ramayana Sankharavam' of the Valmiki Research Centre (National Sanskrit University) held on 20 September?
x: It was held on 20 September at the Vizianagaram campus, on ethical and constitutional lessons from the Valmiki Ramayana.

It is a launch centre of ISRO
It has only one operational launch pad

The striped dolphin is listed as Least Concern by the IUCN

Mangoes protected by the covers fetched double the price.

s:

Malaysia Open Super 500 and Japan Open Super 500
Indonesia Masters Super 750 and Thailand Open Super 500
All England Open and India Open

x: Boyi Bhimanna won in 1975 (Gudisale Kalipotunnayi), T. Patanjali Sastry in 2023 and Penugonda Lakshminarayana in 2024 (Deepika).

s: Who among the following is associated with the literary work Ramayana Kalpavruksham?
x: Viswanatha Satyanarayana of Vijayawada was a literary figure, a Jnanpith awardee and the author associated with Ramayana Kalpavruksham.

s: A regional centre of the Sahitya Akademi has been proposed for which place in Andhra Pradesh?
x: A Sahitya Akademi regional centre has been proposed for Kadapa.

s: For which work did Penugonda Lakshminarayana win the Telugu Sahitya Akademi Award 2024?
x: His 2024 award was for 'Deepika', a work of criticism; Deepika Reddy is the Kuchipudi dancer, not the book.

s: Who is the author of 'Animesha', which won the 2025 Telugu Sahitya Akademi Award?
x: Nandini Sidha Reddy, from Medak in Telangana, won the 2025 Telugu award for the poetry collection 'Animesha'.

s: For which work did Boyi Bhimanna receive the Sahitya Akademi Award in 1975?
x: Boyi Bhimanna won the 1975 Sahitya Akademi Award for 'Gudisale Kalipotunnayi'.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Sahitya Akademi Awards 2025:
1. They were announced on 16 March 2026.
2. The award carries ₹1 lakh and a copper plaque.
3. The Telugu award went to a writer from Andhra Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The 2025 Telugu award went to Nandini Sidha Reddy, who is from Telangana.

s: In how many languages is the Sahitya Akademi Award given?
x: It is given in 24 languages: the 22 Eighth Schedule languages plus English and Rajasthani.

s: Who won the Sahitya Akademi Bal Sahitya Puraskar 2023 (Telugu) for 'Vajrala Vana'?
x: D.K. Chaduvula Babu won the Bal Sahitya Puraskar 2023 (Telugu) for Vajrala Vana.

s: With whom is Telugu Language Day, observed on 29 August, linked?
x: Telugu Language Day (29 August) is linked to Gidugu Venkata Ramamurthy, who is not a Jnanpith winner.

s: For which work did T. Patanjali Sastry receive the Sahitya Akademi Award 2023 (Telugu)?
x: T. Patanjali Sastry won the 2023 Telugu Sahitya Akademi Award for his short-story collection 'Rameswaram Kakulu Marikonni Kathalu'.

s: 'Rameswaram Kakulu Marikonni Kathalu', which won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2023 (Telugu), belongs to which genre?
x: It is a collection of short stories by T. Patanjali Sastry.

s:
Consider the following State symbols of residual Andhra Pradesh:
1. Rose-ringed Parakeet – State bird
2. Jasmine – State flower
3. Blackbuck – State animal
Which of the above pairs are correctly matched?
x: All three are correct; the Rose-ringed Parakeet, Jasmine and Blackbuck (with Neem as State tree) are the symbols of residual AP.

s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched in the comparison of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana symbols?
o: Andhra Pradesh — Neem; Telangana — Jammi Chettu
Andhra Pradesh — Blackbuck; Telangana — Indian Roller
Andhra Pradesh — Rose-ringed Parakeet; Telangana — Palapitta
x: The Telangana animal symbol is Jinka, meaning deer, not Indian Roller. Indian Roller, or Palapitta, is the Telangana state bird.

s: Which is the State tree of residual Andhra Pradesh?
x: Neem is the State tree of residual AP; Red Sanders is endemic to Seshachalam but is not the State tree, and Jammi Chettu is Telangana's.

s: Jammi Chettu is the State tree of which State?
x: Jammi Chettu is Telangana's State tree; residual Andhra Pradesh's State tree is Neem (Vepa).

s: Mannava Satyanarayana, among the Ugadi 2026 awardees, is noted for which distinction?
o: Being the first visually impaired recipient of the Padma Bhushan
Being the first Telugu writer to receive the Jnanpith Award
Being the first Telugu artist to win the Raghupathi Venkaiah Award
Being the first visually impaired PhD in literature in India
x: Mannava Satyanarayana was recognised as the first visually impaired PhD in literature in India.

s: The Nandi Awards and Nandi Natakotsavams are being revived through which organisation?
x: The Nandi Awards and Nandi Natakotsavams are being revived through the Andhra Pradesh Film Development Corporation (APFDC).

s: The Raghupathi Venkaiah Award is associated with which of the following?
x: The Raghupathi Venkaiah Award is the Nandi lifetime honour for Telugu cinema.

s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
x: Gowrabathini Ramanaiah is associated with Venkatagiri handloom weaving. Swimming is associated with Tamogna Mothukuri.

s: For which art form is Ugadi 2026 awardee D. Sivamma known?
x: D. Sivamma is a leather puppetry (Tholu Bommalata) artiste and a Shilp Guru 2023 awardee.

s: Ugadi 2026 awardee Gorrela Krishna Murthy is a narrator of which art form?
x: Gorrela Krishna Murthy is a Burrakatha narrator (burra and two vantalu) with about 5,000 shows.

s: Tamogna Mothukuri of Gudivada, honoured on Ugadi 2026, swam across which lake at the age of five?
x: Tamogna Mothukuri crossed Lake Bodensee (6.3 km) at age 5 and received an Ugadi 2026 award for swimming.

s: On Ugadi 2026, the Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister presented which of the following State honours?
x: On 20 March 2026 the CM gave 38 Kala Ratna and 122 Ugadi awards for Ugadi 2026. Option B swaps the two numbers, and the other options use wrong counts.
